implemented_archive_workflow.settings: Existing per-bot STORAGE_CHANNEL; no production configuration changed.
implemented_archive_workflow.creation: Owner-only private /custom_batch first last or /batch first last, 1–50 source messages, live caller/bot archive-admin checks. /custom_batch ids id1 id2 … supports 1–50 non-contiguous unique messages in the supplied order; explicit selections are stored as a server-side SQL array, never trusted from a start payload. Reply-only /custom_batch resolves a forwarded message from the configured archive. Range and explicit selections accept exact private t.me/c/channel/message links bound to the configured archive; foreign channels and URL suffixes are rejected.
implemented_archive_workflow.redemption: Private /start archive_<opaque token>, tenant-scoped SQL grants, 24-hour expiry. Copies from Telegram without downloading. Durable per-request pending/applied/unconfirmed intent and confirmed-copy count; duplicate same-message requests never replay. Creator and bot archive-admin membership are rechecked at redemption.
remaining: Interactive multi-step range wizard; direct forwarded-message and private channel-URL inputs are supported
Consolidating /genlink ownership without breaking existing Linkshare commands
Full source parity, reference verification/force-subscribe flows and live Telegram validation
implemented_archive_workflow.revocation: Private Owner /custom_batch revoke token; creator and tenant enforced. Expiry/revocation rechecked before each copy. An in-flight Telegram copy may complete after revocation; no automatic retry.
implemented_archive_workflow.delivery_ledger: Each copy has a durable pending intent, confirmed destination message ID on success, or explicit unconfirmed outcome on exception. Parent confirmed count is saved after each successful copy. Crashes leave pending intents, never automatically replayed.
implemented_archive_workflow.limits: Optional --hours=1..168 (default 24), --uses=1..10000 (default unlimited until expiry). SQL row lock serializes admission across concurrent requests. Each admitted request consumes one use even if interrupted; replayed request IDs consume no extra use. No automatic refunds/retries for uncertain Telegram outcomes.
